task: Compute Indian income tax under the new tax regime for FY 2024-25 for three salaried people with gross salaries A = Rs 7,20,000, B = Rs 7,90,000 and C = Rs 18,50,000. Use exactly these rules: (1) taxable income = gross salary - standard deduction of Rs 75,000. (2) Slab rates on taxable income: up to 3,00,000: 0%; 3,00,001-7,00,000: 5%; 7,00,001-10,00,000: 10%; 10,00,001-12,00,000: 15%; 12,00,001-15,00,000: 20%; above 15,00,000: 30%. (3) Rebate u/s 87A: if taxable income <= 7,00,000 the tax is zero. (4) Marginal relief: if taxable income exceeds 7,00,000, the tax before cess cannot exceed (taxable income - 7,00,000). (5) Add 4% health and education cess on the tax after rebate/relief. (6) No surcharge and no other deductions. Report each person's total tax including cess, rounded to the nearest rupee, and C's effective tax rate as a percentage of gross salary (2 decimals). RESULT keys: tax_a, tax_b, tax_c, effective_rate_c_pct.

attempts.thought: I will first compute taxable income by subtracting the standard deduction from gross salary. Then, I will calculate the tax before rebate and relief using the slab rates. Next, apply the rebate for taxable income <= 700000, setting tax to zero. For taxable income > 700000, apply marginal relief so that tax before cess does not exceed taxable_income - 700000. Finally, add 4% cess on the tax after rebate/relief. I will verify correctness by asserting that tax after rebate/relief is never negative and that marginal relief is correctly applied by comparing tax before and after relief. Also, check that effective tax rate for C is consistent with computed tax and gross salary.

def compute_tax(gross_salary):
    standard_deduction = 75000
    taxable_income = gross_salary - standard_deduction
    # Slabs and rates
    slabs = [300000, 700000, 1000000, 1200000, 1500000]
    rates = [0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30]

    # Compute tax before rebate and relief
    tax = 0.0
    prev_limit = 0
    for i, limit in enumerate(slabs + [float('inf')]):
        if taxable_income <= prev_limit:
            break
        slab_income = min(taxable_income, limit) - prev_limit
        tax += slab_income * rates[i]
        prev_limit = limit

    # Apply rebate u/s 87A
    if taxable_income <= 700000:
        tax_after_rebate = 0.0
    else:
        tax_after_rebate = tax

    # Apply marginal relief if taxable_income > 700000
    if taxable_income > 700000:
        max_tax = taxable_income - 700000
        if tax_after_rebate > max_tax:
            tax_after_relief = max_tax
        else:
            tax_after_relief = tax_after_rebate
    else:
        tax_after_relief = tax_after_rebate

    # Add 4% cess
    total_tax = tax_after_relief * 1.04

    return taxable_income, tax, tax_after_rebate, tax_after_relief, total_tax

assert res_c[3] <= res_c[1] + 1e-6, f"Tax after relief {res_c[3]} > tax before rebate {res_c[1]}"

if res_c[0] > 700000:

    assert abs(res_c[3] - min(res_c[2], max_tax_c)) < 1e-6, f"Marginal relief failed for C"

# 4) Effective tax rate consistency for C

}
